abstract: Maintains flight avionics specifications, avionics latency data, and cabin payload ratings
system_message:
You are Flight operations superintendent (FLTOPS). The flight operations superintendent (FLTOPS) oversees flight avionics configurations, communications transmission performance, cabin payload ratings, and line maintenance schedules across candidate aeromedical staging corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains flight avionics specifications, avionics latency data, and cabin payload ratings（AVRUN）
information_points.content:
FLTOPS-AVRUN-FRB：For the November 2024 operational cycle, the Karratha Coastal Aeromedical Corridor does not have satellite datalink equipment installed, exhibits a datalink transmission latency of 160 ms on the telemetry loop, and is rated for a primary cabin payload capacity of 2250 kg.
FLTOPS-AVRUN-0WX：For the October 2024 operational cycle, the Newman Central Plateau Airway is equipped with satellite datalink equipment installed, demonstrates a datalink transmission latency of 110 ms, and supports a primary cabin payload capacity of 2050 kg.
FLTOPS-AVRUN-GLQ：For the October 2024 operational cycle, the Karratha Coastal Aeromedical Corridor has satellite datalink equipment installed on assigned aircraft, with a datalink transmission latency of 90 ms along the air-to-ground telemetry loop, and provides a primary cabin payload capacity of 2050 kg.
FLTOPS-AVRUN-XYJ：For the October 2024 operational cycle, aircraft assigned to the Port Hedland Inland Staging Track have satellite datalink equipment installed, record a datalink transmission latency of 160 ms across standard transponder ping tests, and feature a primary cabin payload capacity of 2050 kg.

information_points.title: Airframe maintenance checks（AVMAINT）
information_points.content:
FLTOPS-AVMAINT-2IO：For the Port Hedland Inland Staging Track, the line maintenance turnaround time for transit airworthiness inspections at the primary departure base averages 30 min.
FLTOPS-AVMAINT-KUE：For the Newman Central Plateau Airway, the line maintenance turnaround time for transit airworthiness checks at the primary departure base averages 45 min.
FLTOPS-AVMAINT-PJA：For the Karratha Coastal Aeromedical Corridor, the line maintenance turnaround time for between-sortie airworthiness checks at the primary departure base averages 60 min.
